revision_note: Inventory of every data class a public clone of Atlas can reach. Public accessibility is not treated as redistribution permission: each entry states the access basis, what Atlas actually stores, and whether redistribution is claimed.

rights_classes.project_authored: Written or generated by this project; licence follows the repository licence (see docs/LICENSING.md; maintainer authorisation pending).
rights_classes.derived_project_authored: Values computed by this project from a stated source; carries the source's constraints as well as the project's.
rights_classes.public_government_work: Published by a U.S. federal agency as part of its official duties. Treated as public domain, with attribution retained.
rights_classes.public_access_with_terms: Publicly retrievable under the publisher's access and reuse terms. Atlas stores derived facts, identifiers and digests, not a republication of the publisher's document set.
rights_classes.restricted_vendor: Licensed for local analysis only. Redistribution is not permitted. Must not be tracked in the distributable tree.

entries.description: Derived SEC XBRL facts, submissions metadata and document hashes for Apple, Microsoft, Walmart, Alphabet, IBM and restatement fixtures.
entries.origin: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, data.sec.gov
entries.redistribution_detail: Atlas stores extracted figures, element names, accession numbers, URLs, byte sizes and SHA-256 digests. It does not redistribute the publisher's full filing document set.
entries.basis: SEC website access and reuse terms; issuer-prepared filing content is not a U.S. Government work, so no public-domain claim is made over narrative text.
entries.verification: fixtures/README.md records retrieval date, user agent, per-file size and digest; fixtures/sec_multi_manifest.json pins the bytes.

entries.description: Question sets, gold labels, frozen holdout protocol, adjudications and the derived XBRL facts used to score them.
entries.origin: Project-authored annotations over SEC XBRL facts
entries.basis: Annotations and questions are project-authored; the facts they reference inherit the SEC entry above.
entries.verification: scripts/answer_semantics_holdout_archive.py verifies frozen artifact hashes at the commits they name.

entries.description: Explicitly synthetic price, dividend and split series plus a project-authored split-adjustment series used by market and backtest tests.
entries.origin: Generated by this project for testing
entries.basis: Not vendor data. Every series is labelled synthetic in its manifest and is never presented as an observed market price.

entries.description: Daily Treasury par yield curve observations for 2024.
entries.basis: Official U.S. Government data published for public use.
entries.verification: Committed CSV; column semantics documented in docs/ECONOMIC_DATA_FABRIC.md.

entries.description: Derived daily ERCOT demand and Dallas-Fort Worth weather panel for 2023.
entries.origin: U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA-930) and NOAA station observations, derived
entries.redistribution_detail: The committed panel is derived; the raw agency archives remain in the ignored var/ tree and are not redistributed.
entries.basis: Official U.S. Government data; the fixture manifest states that the panel is an observation, not a forecast, and that the current bulk archive is not an as-issued vintage.

entries.description: FFIEC FR Y-9C quarterly holding-company archive, the FFIEC financial download dictionary and two FDIC BankFind Call Report payloads.
entries.origin: FFIEC National Information Center and FDIC BankFind
entries.basis: Official U.S. Government regulatory data published for public download.
entries.verification: fixtures/regulatory/README.md records retrieval URL, size, SHA-256 and archive member details.

entries.description: Declarative application packages, energy research pack and their expected outputs.
entries.origin: Project-authored declarative packages over derived public data
entries.basis: Declarative JSON and pipeline definitions authored by this project. No executable package code is committed.
entries.verification: scripts/verify_distributable_fixtures.py and the application package contract tests.

entries.description: Generated evaluation, benchmark, audit, screenshot and release artifacts.
entries.origin: Generated by this project from the sources above
entries.redistribution_detail: Artifacts may quote short SEC figures and accessions under the SEC entry; no vendor market series is included after the Phase 9.2 rights remediation.
entries.basis: Project outputs. Any figure traces to a public source entry in this inventory.
entries.verification: scripts/release_manifest.py hashes every tracked file; scripts/audit_distribution.py re-scans the tree for restricted data.

entries.description: Repository documentation, specification and research reports.
entries.basis: Authored by this project. ATLAS_MASTER_SPEC.md is a project-authored specification document.
entries.verification: scripts/verify_master_spec.py checks the specification's byte identity.

entries.description: The synthetic annual report the offline demonstration ingests so an installed Atlas can produce an answer certificate without a network call.
entries.origin: Project-authored HTML: a fictional registrant ('Atlas Demonstration Industries, Inc.'), no CIK, no securities, every figure invented.
entries.basis: Written for this repository and distributed with the source tree; it states on its face that it is synthetic. No separate licence is granted beyond the repository's terms (see docs/LICENSING.md; maintainer authorisation pending).
entries.verification: The file carries no real registrant or vendor data; its figures are labelled synthetic and are exercised by tests/test_demo_financial_answer.py.

entries.description: Nasdaq and Alpha Vantage price series committed before the Phase 9.2 rights remediation. Removed from the tree by commit 96a398b but still reachable through the blobs of earlier commits on published branches.
entries.origin: Nasdaq and Alpha Vantage, retrieved under a personal-analysis licence
entries.basis: Vendor terms permit local analysis, not republication. Public accessibility of the repository does not create redistribution rights.
entries.verification: scripts/audit_distribution.py reports these paths under history.restricted_vendor_paths_reachable; the current tree must contain none of them.
entries.remediation: Requires a rewritten or fresh-history distribution branch, authorised by the maintainer, because existing clones and forks retain the old objects. Not performed here.
